main:1.text: The first objective of the game is for Cody and May is to pull a lever to lower a staircase, this first room also includes a bell, wide metal can that can be rolled around, and a few jars that Cody and May can ground pound to smash. After the lever is pulled with the help of both players, instead of the staircase going down, three fuses end up flying away, two of them stand still leaving the last one to run away.
